hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: NDOT's only published costs (ne_hso_costs_2020, p. 1) are economic costs per person, not per crash: $1,550,000 per death, $90,000 per disabling (A), $26,000 per visible (B), $21,000 per possible (C) injury, and $4,200 per property-damage crash; NTIP gives no person counts to price them

statewide_rates.missing: NDOT publishes no statewide average crash-rate table CrashIQ can use, and CrashIQ has no Nebraska traffic counts
